title: Listening field

techniques.name: Character field

world.label: World
world.note: The page’s three worlds: 1 Frequency (signal as sculpture), 2 Afterimage (memory), 3 Redline (words under pressure).

state.label: Presence
state.note: The page’s three presence states: 1 listening, 2 reaching, 3 at rest.

techniques.implementation: Characters are placed as a field: a spiral of letters, an ellipse of marks. Drawn by the source page’s own code; each dial sets one of the page’s own controls.

techniques.name: Measured inks
techniques.implementation: solid ink pixels of each figure, read at full resolution, are clustered to five colors; a color is kept when it holds at least 4% of the ink.

techniques.name: Figure and ground
techniques.implementation: The ground is the most common border color of a figure; ink is every pixel more than 40 levels from it.

pass_order: read · points measured from the figure
